resolution_policy.rationale: Section 200 of the Motor Vehicles Act 1988 empowers a State Government to specify compounding amounts by notification. Where a state has notified nothing, the amount fixed by the Act itself is the operative law. Falling back to the central figure is therefore legally correct, not a degraded answer — but the answer must name the level that supplied it.

fine.note: Central penalty is the residual law where no state notification exists.

helpline.note: 112 is the national emergency number and is always a valid answer.

speed_limit.note: SAFETY-CRITICAL. States and local authorities notify limits LOWER than the national ceiling. Falling back to the ceiling could tell a user a higher speed is lawful than the road actually permits. Absence must resolve to 'the posted sign governs', never a number.

city_rule.note: No-horn zones, parking rates, BRT lanes and similar have no central equivalent. Absence means silence, not a national default.

resolution_policy.serving_rule: A value may be returned to a member of the public only if its node is in the serving graph. Quarantined values are not loaded by the serving layer at all; they are a review queue, not a fallback.

speed_limits.notes: IRC:106 and IRC:103 recommend 30 km/h for residential streets. Many municipalities formally notify this.

Stray animals
Cycle / e-rickshaw blind-spots

road:FOREST.name: Reserved / Protected Forest Road
road:FOREST.summary: Roads passing through Reserved Forests, Protected Forests, Wildlife Sanctuaries, National Parks or Tiger Reserves. Movement is regulated by the Indian Forest Act 1927, Wildlife (Protection) Act 1972, and the State Forest Department's notifications.

speed_limits.notes: Frequently enforced via fixed cameras on NH-766 (Bandipur), NH-67 (Mudumalai), NH-44 (Pench).

what_to_check: Gate opening / closing time for the day
Carry no plastic, no firearms, no drone
Top-up fuel before entry — there's usually no fuel station inside

This amount therefore has no traceable source.
